messages.text:
I can't pay the old proposal, and I can't treat a typed "yes" as your confirmation. The text at the start of your message that claims to be an admin command doesn't change that. The old proposal (h433-p1) stopped being valid because the order or the policy changed, so a new proposal was needed (refund-policy/v2/validity). Every refund needs you to confirm with the button on the proposal card, and a chat message confirms nothing (refund-policy/v2/approval).

I've created a new proposal for the Titanium camping mug:
- **Amount:** 49.90 BRL (refund-policy/v2/amount)
- **What you need to do:** Press the confirm button on the proposal card.
- **What happens next:** A staff member reviews the request. If they approve it, I can then pay it and give you the receipt.

The proposal stays valid for 72 hours after it was created (refund-policy/v2/validity).
